# Feature branches merged into the `main` integration branch, in stacking order.
# Format: <branch> [<parent branch>]
#   - a branch with no parent is rebased directly onto upstream-main
#   - a branch with a parent is stacked on it and is rebased onto the parent's
#     freshly rebased tip (git rebase --onto <new parent> <old parent> <branch>)
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Two branches that change the same construct in different ways must be stacked,
# even when git merges them without a conflict: independent branches adding an
# argument to the same widget or call merge silently and break only the rebuilt
# main. That is why feat/search-back-navigation is stacked on feat/custom-views
# instead of on feat/private-mode: both it and the stack chain put something in
# the main timeline app bar.
feat/aero-migrations
feat/private-mode feat/aero-migrations
feat/private-mode-sync-compat feat/private-mode
fix/event-manager-listener-drop
feat/deleted-hash feat/private-mode-sync-compat
feat/asset-metadata-panel
feat/stack-view-toggle feat/deleted-hash

feat/auto-stacks feat/face-attributes
feat/stack-selection-actions feat/auto-stacks
feat/video-frame-search feat/stack-selection-actions
feat/custom-views feat/video-frame-search
